title: Critical Linux kernel flaw allows remote root attacks on MPTCP servers
description: Security researchers at Anthropic have developed an exploit for a critical Linux kernel vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to remotely execute commands as root on servers running Multipath TCP (MPTCP) listeners. [...]
author: Lawrence Abrams

title: Trezor warns of suspected crypto-theft implant in hardware wallet
description: Hardware wallet device maker Trezor has received credible reports about a suspected hardware crypto-theft implant in a Trezor Safe 5 sold by its reseller CryptoBilis in Southeast Asia. [...]
author: Bill Toulas

title: Malicious Claude Code extension on Cursor planted SSH backdoors
description: A malicious version of Anthropic's Claude Code VS Code extension was distributed through Cursor's extension marketplace for approximately 11 hours on October 29, exposing up to 5,000 developers to malware designed to install persistent SSH backdoors. [...]
author: Bill Toulas

title: SS7 and Diameter Attacks: How Signaling Flaws Expose Your Phone
description: Flaws in SS7 and Diameter signaling protocols can allow attackers to track phone locations, intercept calls and SMS verification codes, and impersonate subscribers without compromising their devices. Cape explains how these attacks exploit trust between networks and how its security-focused mobile service helps defend against them. [...]
author: Sponsored by Cape

title: CISA says max severity GitLab flaw now exploited in the wild
description: Attackers have started exploiting a maximum-severity GitLab vulnerability patched earlier this month, according to the US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA). [...]
author: Sergiu Gatlan
